Message:
pinctrl: renesas: r8a7790: Optimize pinctrl image size for R8A7742

This driver supports both RZ/G1H and R-Car H2 SoCs.
Optimize pinctrl image size for RZ/G1H, when support for R-Car H2
(R8A7790) is not enabled.
